maddeler.e:
تعرقبتن (form IIq)
# تَعَرْقَبْتُنَّ (taʕarqabtunna) /ta.ʕar.qab.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تُعُرْقِبْتُنَّ (tuʕurqibtunna) /tu.ʕur.qib.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
